_note: Limb zones of ordinary enemies (GDD limb-zones §3, §7). Rect per zone: [x0, x1, y0, y1], x in fractions of the hit box width w measured FORWARD from the feet (mirrored by face), y in fractions of the height h measured UP from the feet. arm: the attacking arm, cut only by a parry while the enemy is in attack_states (a shield arm is not listed). head: knocked off only by a down-air strike while the enemy is in attack_states (arm_states, when present, narrows the arm to those states: the thrower's shove). Both zones also decide the death variant (death_sever_chance otherwise). one_arm: stat multipliers after the arm is cut. tough: needs limb_elite_hits_needed parries / hits per limb (as elites do). death_only: beasts, a part flies only as part of the death. arm_colour: a stat key or a colour. arm_len px and arm_root [x, y] fractions: the flying arm and the stump. Kinds missing here have no zones (bat, bloat, jelly, dummy, bosses).
